Here are the top 15 moments from the 11-hour livestream that would make the most viral and funniest YouTube Shorts, ranked by their viral potential.

1. **The Professional Art Defacement**
    *   **Timestamp:** [00:08:15]
    *   **Hook Description:** When you accidentally ruin 72 hours of work with one click.
    *   **Quote:** "Three days... and you defaced it with a penis... In my defense, I drew the penis as a joke and then I escaped and it stayed there." [1-3]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The contrast between the team’s genuine horror at the "real artists" who spent days on the piece and Peanut’s panicked, accidental defacement is peak absurdist gaming comedy. [2, 3]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Absurdist.

2. **The 30,000-Hour Berry Logic**
    *   **Timestamp:** [01:12:47]
    *   **Hook Description:** Having 30,000 hours in Rust but failing at basic gardening.
    *   **Quote:** "You have 30,000 hours and you don't know how berries work?... You say one more zen zesty chakra alignment bull crap to me without telling me how to put the berries back in the thing I'm going to **** you." [4, 5]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut performs the actual math on how many years of full-time work 30,000 hours is just to roast his teammate for not knowing if berries have seeds. [6, 7]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Dry-joke.

3. **The Dr. Disrespect Riddle**
    *   **Timestamp:** [06:11:40]
    *   **Hook Description:** Pirate Software’s riskiest riddle at the Rust Chili's.
    *   **Quote:** "What is Dr. Disrespect’s favorite Rust monument?... Mining outpost... because there’s lots of miners." [8, 9]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** It’s a high-risk, "edgy" joke delivered with perfect dry timing by a role-player pretending to be a restaurant manager. [9]
    *   **Setup Needed:** Yes (occurs during the "Chili's" roleplay segment). [10]
    *   **Humor Type:** Dry-joke.

4. **The "Mandatory Required **** You Die"**
    *   **Timestamp:** [05:01:28]
    *   **Hook Description:** Peanut invents a new technical term for failing a raid.
    *   **Quote:** "He had a... mandatory required **** you die. You ever heard one of those? It’s a technical term. You might not have heard of it because you don't know a lot about computers." [11]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut tries to gaslight the enemy team by pretending a technical malfunction was actually a deliberate "fair play" move, using a hilariously aggressive made-up name. [11, 12]
    *   **Setup Needed:** Yes (happens after the failed "Make-A-Wish" raid). [13]
    *   **Humor Type:** Character-moment.

5. **The "Big Suck 3000" Tour**
    *   **Timestamp:** [00:26:47]
    *   **Hook Description:** When your base automation sounds a little too suggestive.
    *   **Quote:** "It will automatically do the big suck and pull it in these boxes... They suck and they gag... They push. They do both." [14, 15]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The base builders are trying to give a serious technical tour, but the name "The Big Suck" leads to a cascade of unintentional (or very intentional) innuendos from Peanut. [15, 16]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Absurdist.

6. **The Runway Model Backup Plan**
    *   **Timestamp:** [01:57:44]
    *   **Hook Description:** YouTuber reveals his surprisingly dark backup career.
    *   **Quote:** "Actually, if I wasn't a streamer, my backup plan was runway model. I was going to stick my fingers down my throat and all the whole package." [17, 18]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The dry, casual delivery of a joke about the dark side of the fashion industry while mindlessly mining rocks is classic Peanut. [18]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Dry-joke.

7. **"Good Boy" Self-Talk**
    *   **Timestamp:** [02:49:00]
    *   **Hook Description:** When the adrenaline hits so hard you start praising yourself.
    *   **Quote:** "Nice shot. Good boy... I don't know why I just complimented myself... I was going to say good job, boys. So, I said nice shots, good boy to myself." [19]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut gets caught in a moment of pure accidental narcissism after a sniper kill and immediately tries to walk it back in embarrassment. [19]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Reaction-gold.

8. **The Indiana Jones Butthole Bunker**
    *   **Timestamp:** [05:22:15]
    *   **Hook Description:** The most "secure" loot spot in Rust.
    *   **Quote:** "You have to dive under water like a **** Indiana Jones movie to **** get the loot... we will see how many can fit... up to five if you lube him up correctly." [20-22]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The escalation from a "secret underwater bunker" to a discussion about the "circumference of Dra’s butthole" for hiding ferrets is a perfect example of how quickly Peanut’s stream devolves into nonsense. [20, 21]
    *   **Setup Needed:** Yes (The "fret rescue" mission). [23]
    *   **Humor Type:** Running-bit.

9. **The Password "6767" Realization**
    *   **Timestamp:** [05:40:24]
    *   **Hook Description:** Realizing your base security is a total joke.
    *   **Quote:** "The code is 6767... You got to be **** kidding me. Is that the code to all the doors? Apparently, everybody knew that." [24]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The slow-motion horror of realizing their "Fort Bungus" base has been using the same simple code that the entire server apparently already knew. [24, 25]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Reaction-gold.

10. **Family Dinner during War**
    *   **Timestamp:** [02:46:58]
    *   **Hook Description:** Trying to enforce a "No Cell Phones" rule during a raid.
    *   **Quote:** "We need to do a ban. We need to sit down at the dinner table and not use our cell phones... technology offline. We do family dinner. We're in the middle of raiding." [26]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut tries to force a wholesome "family" roleplay moment while the team is literally being shot at and trying to manage comms. [26, 27]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Character-moment.

11. **Rogue's "Triple Threat"**
    *   **Timestamp:** [07:44:31]
    *   **Hook Description:** Caught on 4K being a terrible guard.
    *   **Quote:** "Rogue is locked in... I see Cam Soda whisk by him on the right... Not only did you shoot me, you also didn't shoot him." [28, 29]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** The team reviews the footage to find Rogue staring intensely in one direction while the enemy literally runs past him twice in plain view. [28, 30]
    *   **Setup Needed:** Yes (The failed "Coconut" raid). [31]
    *   **Humor Type:** Callback.

12. **The "Scumbag" Recruitment Speech**
    *   **Timestamp:** [08:12:31]
    *   **Hook Description:** Looking for a teammate with "no morals."
    *   **Quote:** "I need a scumbag... a piece of garbage, a piece of ****. Someone who is so willing to win they are willing to do any tactic... running naked into a base to steal rockets. That's you." [32, 33]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut gives a dramatic, cinematic speech trying to recruit a "pro" by calling them every insult imaginable and framing it as a job requirement. [32, 34]
    *   **Setup Needed:** Yes (Peanut's frustration with "Rust Pros"). [35, 36]
    *   **Humor Type:** Character-moment.

13. **The Vietnam Trumpet / Skin Flute**
    *   **Timestamp:** [01:34:01]
    *   **Hook Description:** The dark history of a Rust trumpet.
    *   **Quote:** "He was playing that trumpet all the way back through the trenches with the other boys... and the skin flute... we honor his sacrifice by keeping his trumpet alive. And there's a plunger in the front of it." [37, 38]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** A role-player tells a tragic war story about a trumpet, which Peanut immediately ruins with crude jokes about "skin flutes" and plungers. [38]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Absurdist.

14. **Microwaved Jack in the Box**
    *   **Timestamp:** [11:00:19]
    *   **Hook Description:** The sad reality of an 11-hour stream ending.
    *   **Quote:** "I'm getting off to microwave Jack in the Box... six tacos, one Jack spicy chicken sandwich... Have you ever had diabetes? No... pouring an Oreo shake on it and then pissing all over it? That's the sauce." [39-41]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** Peanut describes a disgusting "ascent" to food heaven involving Oreo shakes and Jack in the Box tacos, leaving everyone genuinely concerned for his health. [41]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Dry-joke.

15. **The "Pixel Refresh" Excuse**
    *   **Timestamp:** [03:44:14]
    *   **Hook Description:** The worst time for your monitor to update.
    *   **Quote:** "My new monitor just restarted itself... it's doing a pixel cleaning... you had to do a quick pixel refresh. Sorry. We had to do a quick pixel refresh." [42, 43]
    *   **Why it’s funny:** During the most intense moment of a raid, Hutch’s high-end monitor forces a "pixel cleaning," leaving him blind while Peanut screams at him to move. [42, 43]
    *   **Setup Needed:** No.
    *   **Humor Type:** Reaction-gold.
